content.concept_description: A player attempts to unravel a dense maze of arrows, repeatedly picking blocked arrows that deplete lives.
content.why_it_works: Seeing someone repeatedly fail an apparently simple arrow-clearing maze while losing lives provokes the viewer to want to prove they can do better.

emotions.emotional_arc: Frustration over repeated failed arrow taps leads to mounting tension as remaining lives are drained.

end_card.cta_and_text: 00:27 - 'Arrow Puzzle', 00:27 - 'This feature is not included in the actual gameplay yet.'

gameplay.core_gameplay_notes: Tapping an unblocked arrow sends it gliding off the board, while tapping a blocked arrow flashes red, sounds an error buzz, and breaks a heart life.

chapterization.chapter_description: A hand taps a blocked arrow, triggering an error highlight and shattering a heart life.
The player tests different arrows across the maze and successfully clears one at the top right.
Frequent incorrect taps cause red screen flashes and drain almost all remaining heart lives.
Final end screen displaying the Arrow Puzzle logo and a gameplay feature disclaimer.
